DSSSB Delhi High Court Attendant Result 2026 – Full Details

Delhi Subordinate Service Selection Board (DSSSB) has released the result for the recruitment of Court Attendant, Room Attendant & Security Attendant post on the official website. This recruitment was released for 334 posts. Applications for the DSSSB Delhi High Court Attendant Recruitment 2026 were accepted from August 26, 2026, to September 24, 2026. The online examination was conducted on 01-03 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their DSSSB Delhi High Court Attendant Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 14 August 2025
  • Application Start Date : 26 August 2025
  • Last Date : 24 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 01-03 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 29 May 2026
  • Result : 30 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PH, Women : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Important Links

  • Download Result
  • Download Result Notice
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is DSSSB Delhi High Court Attendant Result 2026?

DSSSB Delhi High Court Attendant Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
